description: Read-only glass card that makes the multipliers legible by showing '$50 {freq} budget -> ${50 x n}/month' for all three frequencies, recomputed live from the current field values. New additive IA element in the frequency redesign; pure presentation, no new data or storage.

baseAmount.description: Illustrative per-occurrence amount; fixed constant, NOT user data

computation: each line result = baseAmount * multiplier, rendered via formatCurrency(result, 0)
loading: During screen load render a single Skeleton height 110 radius radius.lg in place of the whole card.

accessibility.perLineLabel: A 50 dollar {freq} budget equals {result} dollars per month
accessibility.decorativeArrows: accessibilityElementsHidden on the arrow glyphs; each line is one SR node
